title: 第17章 镇压天兵天将第18章 大王你抓的这些人脑子都有病
slug: 西游反正很无聊随便打个劫呗
lines: “大胆强盗，竟然敢阻挠取经大业。”
托塔李天王威严的声音，传遍了整个山谷。
“你说什么取经？再大一点声。”
楚云挠了挠耳朵说道。
李天王一眼就看出对方是故意的。
“哪吒，本王命你速速前去擒拿此贼！”
父王放心。”
随后哪吒三太子便下了云头，直奔楚云而来。
两人站在小河边。
“你这强盗还不束手就擒？”
哪咤三太子手拿火尖枪，另外一只手指着楚云说道。
“有本事你就过来拿我啊？”
哪咤知道这条小河是禁魔之地的分界线。
只要跨过小河。
会失去所有的仙力，只能通过本体的力量和对方肉搏。
“我为什么要过去？”
“你来抓我的，你不过来怎么抓我？”
“你可以先投降自己走过来。”
“是你傻还是我傻，我会投降？”
对于这些激将法，楚云嗤之以鼻，他早就免疫了。
“不如这样，我们互相让对方打三掌，看谁撑的掌数多，就算是赢。”
三太子一听。
或许这是一个办法，可以将对方骗出禁魔之地。
“可以，不过先让我打你！”
“行，你来吧！”
楚云站在河边，一脸无所谓的说道。
“那你先出来！”
“我偏不出去，有本事你过来！”
哪咤三太子双眼提溜乱转。
“可以，不过要公平起见，你也要出来打我！”
楚云心中冷笑，他怎么还看不出哪咤的计策，无非就是想骗他出禁魔之地。
看来斗木獬逃回去，给他们提供了不少的情报。
知道在禁魔之地比拼武艺，不是楚云的对手。
天上的李天王已经将宝塔拿了出来。
content_en:
"The bold robber dares to obstruct the great cause of learning scriptures."
The majestic voice of King Tota Li spread throughout the valley.
"What do you mean by learning from scriptures? Louder."
Chu Yun scratched his ears and said.
Li Tianwang could tell at a glance that the other party did it on purpose.
"Nezha, I order you to go quickly and capture this thief!"
"Yes!
Father, don't worry. "
Then the third prince Nezha got off the clouds and went straight to Chu Yun.
The two of them stood by the river.
"Why don't you, the robber, catch you without any help?"
The third prince Nezha held a fire-tip spear in his hand and pointed at Chu Yun with the other hand.
"Come and get me if you can?"
Nezha knew that this small river was the dividing line of the Forbidden Demon Land.
Just cross the river.
He will lose all his immortal power and can only fight with the opponent through the power of his body.
"Why should I go there?"
"You came to catch me. How can you catch me if you don't come?"
"You can surrender and come over by yourself first."
"Are you stupid or am I stupid that I will surrender?"
Chu Yun sneered at these provocative methods. He had long been immune to them.
"How about this, let's give each other three slaps, and see who can get more slaps, we will win."
The third prince heard this.
Maybe this is a way to trick the other party out of the forbidden magic place.
"Okay, but let me hit you first!"
"Okay, come on!"
Chu Yun stood by the river and said with an indifferent expression.
"Then you come out first!"
"I won't go out. If you can, come here!"
The Third Prince Nezha's eyes were darting around.
"Okay, but to be fair, you have to come out and beat me too!"
Chu Yun sneered in his heart, why couldn't he see through Nezha's plan, which was just to trick him out of the forbidden demon place.
It seems that Doumu Xie escaped and provided them with a lot of information.
He knew that Chu Yun was no match for him in a martial arts competition in the Forbidden Demon Land.
King Li Tian in the sky has taken out the pagoda.
